'''Chapter 1020''' is titled "Robin vs. Black Maria".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Denjiro]] dreaming of eating a giant shrimp tempura as he chews his own pompadour" by PN 420 Land. 

==Short Summary==
On the [[Skull Dome]] roof, [[Kaidou]] insists that [[Yamato]]'s [[Devil Fruit]], the [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami]], be used to rule over [[Wano Country]] and keep it guarded. However, Yamato refuses and promises to liberate Wano's populace to the outside world as the two of them clash with elemental breath attacks.

Meanwhile, [[Black Maria]] tries attacking [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Brook]] with an "illusion mist" which causes illusions of those they love to appear; however, the duo quickly see through and attack them. As Brook takes down Maria's living weapon [[Wanyudo]] and confronts the rest of her subordinates, Maria derides [[Sanji]] and the rest of the Straw Hats' seeming weakness for making Robin face her. However, Robin swiftly rejects this claim as she generates a giant [[Hana Hana no Mi|clone of herself]] to confront Maria.

On the Wano mainland, [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Shinobu]] have found [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], who is conscious and alert after having eaten meat. Needing to get back to [[Onigashima]] and finish off Kaidou, Luffy asks Momonosuke to fly him up there.

==Long Summary==
Atop the [[Skull Dome]]'s roof, [[Kaidou]] tells [[Yamato]] that the [[Devil Fruit]] the latter once ate from—the [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami]]—is a very valuable [[Zoan#Mythical Zoan|Mythical Zoan]] fruit, and that it was a mistake to let Yamato, someone claiming to be [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]], gain its power because the "Okuchi no Makami" is [[Wano Country|Wano]]'s "Guardian Deity". Kaidou states that, thus, Yamato ought to protect Wano for him, which the latter refuses, but Kaidou simply says that [[Orochi]] had a talent for exploitation, and seeing how his actions turned Wano into such a great weapons factory, all they have to do is take control and keep it running. Yamato, however, says that he plans on helping to protect the country from Kaidou and to open it up, before unleashing a blast of some kind from his mouth called [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami#Techniques|'''Namuji Hyoga''']], which Kaidou counters with his '''Bolo Breath''', before saying that he will not let that happen.

In the Third Floor's Banquet Hall, [[Nico Robin]] is approached by what appears to be her departed loved ones: her mother [[Nico Olvia]], her mentor [[Clou D. Clover|Professor Clover]], and [[Jaguar D. Saul]]. The three tell her to approach them and Robin starts to do so with her arms open. [[Brook]], however, tries to tell her over and over not to go to them, and sure enough, she stops and admits the enemy is trying to fool her, using [[Hana Hana no Mi#Limbs|'''Tres Mano: Freesia''']] to strike the fakes and expose them as [[Black Maria]]'s subordinates: [[SMILE]] eaters [[Nure-Onna]] and [[Tenjo-Sagari]], and female [[Numbers|Number]] [[Kunyun]], who had been disguised by Black Maria's [[Black Maria#Illlusion Mist|'''Illusion Mist''']]. As Brook and Robin then run from Black Maria and her lackeys through a hallway, Brook tells Robin that she should have given him a sign that she was not affected by their trick. Robin notes how Brook was unaffected as well, who explains that it was because he was adrift in the [[Florian Triangle]] for fifty years and would dream about his deceased crew being alive, so he became used to being hurt by illusions. Robin offhandedly remarks how similar the two of them are due to all their past trauma, just as Black Maria uses '''[[Wanyudo#Techniques|Furisode Wanyudo]]''' to strike at them, but misses. Her weapon, the staff whose head portion is a flaming wanyudo, is revealed to be another SMILE user aptly named [[Wanyudo]], a man who ate a pug SMILE and is keeping the staff's fire lit by running around in its wheel like a hamster.

Black Maria jumps onto the ceiling, using her [[Kumo Kumo no Mi, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli|spider silk]] to keep herself suspended upside-down, and declares that her foes are clearly dreaming if they think that they could beat Kaidou. The two [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] dodge Black Maria's staff-whirling attack, which sets the floor ablaze. Robin uses '''Spider Net''' to keep herself, and Brook, hanging from the ceiling as well, exclaiming how Black Maria will burn down the whole castle if she continues like that. Black Maria sarcastically thanks her for her worry and notes how, perhaps, Robin ought to just surrender and let herself get caught. Brook, though, uses a move called [[Yomi Yomi no Mi#Post-Timeskip Techniques|'''Cold Soul''']] to freeze the Wanyudo, eliminating the fires. Infuriated, Black Maria swings at Robin, causing her to let go of the ceiling. As she falls, Black Maria insults Robin by saying that, deep down, she knows the Straw Hats will sell her out, while Brook freezes the fire on the ground using '''Soul Parade''' so Robin may land safely.

Black Maria says that [[Sanji]] knew she was hunting Robin and yet still called the latter to their location, arguing that Robin is simply baggage to her friends due to the powerful figures that are after her. She adds that, with Sanji now the laughingstock of [[Onigashima]], yet having the Straw Hats' number-two bounty, their crew must truly be low-level. Robin and Brook are unfazed by Black Maria's insults, and Brook simply asks Robin if she would like to take care of Black Maria by herself from this point on, which Robin confirms, leaving Black Maria's subordinates to Brook. Robin tells Black Maria that her insults mean nothing because she knows how kind Sanji is, and Black Maria would never understand what it means for him to rely upon Robin. Calling Sanji one of the "[[Pirate#Pirate King|Pirate King]]'s Two Wings" that will allow [[Monkey D. Luffy|him]] to soar, Robin then shows off a new technique, [[Hana Hana no Mi#Other Body Parts 2|'''Gigante Fleur''']], to create a giant, multi-armed clone of herself behind her.

Down at [[Udon#Tokage Port|Udon's Tokage Port]], [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Shinobu]] have reunited with Luffy and the [[Heart Pirates]], who have given Luffy all of their food, yet he still demands more meat. Momonosuke is relieved to see Luffy alive but starts crying over what happened with [[Kin'emon]] and [[Kikunojo]], but Luffy tells him to not cry yet until Kaidou is beaten. Off in the distance, [[Caribou]] watches Luffy with the others and demands Luffy get himself together or he (Caribou) will never be able to escape Wano. Luffy then points up into the air, at the floating Onigashima, and tells Momonosuke that he needs him to help take him back up to the island, by transforming into a [[Artificial Devil Fruit|dragon]] and flying him up there.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Yamato]] continues to battle against [[Kaidou]].
**Yamato is revealed to have eaten the [[Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Okuchi no Makami]]: a [[Zoan#Mythical Zoan|Mythical Zoan]]-type fruit of which the animal is revered as a Guardian Deity of [[Wano Country]].
**Yamato uses a breath attack that Kaidou counters with his ''Bolo Breath''.
*[[Black Maria]]'s battle with [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Brook]] is shown.
**With the assistance of illusionary mist created by Black Maria, her subordinates disguise themselves as people from Robin's past: her mother [[Nico Olvia|Olvia]], her mentor [[Clou D. Clover|Clover]], and her friend [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]].
***Said subordinates are [[Nure-Onna]], a hognose snake [[SMILE]] user, [[Tenjo-Sagari]], a white snake SMILE user, and a [[Numbers|Number]] called [[Kunyun]].
**Black Maria's weapon is revealed to be operated by [[Wanyudo]], a pug SMILE user.
**Robin faces Black Maria alone while Brook faces her subordinates.
**Robin uses a new technique, ''Gigante Fleur'', to create a massive clone of herself with many arms.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and the [[Heart Pirates]] reach the shore and are reunited with [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] and [[Shinobu]] at [[Udon#Tokage Port|Tokage Port]].
**[[Caribou]] is also present nearby, but he is hiding from the group.
**Luffy asks Momonosuke to fly him back to [[Onigashima]].
